Help

How many hours do Pro and MAX include, and how are they counted?

Pro includes 5 hours of transcription a week or 20 hours a month, and MAX includes 10 hours a week or 40 hours a month. Hours are the length of the audio you send to be transcribed, and unused plan hours don’t roll over to the next period.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: November 2, 2026

How many hours does each plan include?

PlanHours included
Pro weekly5 hours a week
Pro monthly20 hours a month
Pro yearly20 hours a month
MAX weekly10 hours a week
MAX monthly40 hours a month
MAX yearly40 hours a month

MAX has twice the hours of Pro. The app shows the hours of each plan before you subscribe. The free plan is unchanged: 60 minutes a month.

What counts as an hour?

  • Hours are transcription time. Verbi’s server measures the length of the audio that is sent to be transcribed: recordings, imported or shared files and YouTube videos all count when they are transcribed.
  • If only the first part of a long file is transcribed, only that part counts.
  • If a transcription fails, the hours it would have used are returned.
  • A recording you save but don’t transcribe doesn’t use hours.
  • Live transcription, summaries, AI Chat and translation don’t use hours.

When do my hours reset?

  • Weekly plans: your hours reset every subscription week. Monthly plans: every subscription month.
  • Yearly plans are paid once a year, but their hours reset every month, counted from the day you bought the plan.
  • Unused plan hours don’t roll over. Extra hours are different: they never expire.
  • The app shows your remaining hours and the date they reset. After a purchase or a renewal, it can take a minute for the new figure to appear.

What if I subscribed before hours existed?

If you subscribed to a Verbi Pro weekly, monthly or yearly plan before the hour-based plans arrived, you keep your price and have no hour limit for as long as that subscription stays active.

Frequently asked questions

Do my plan hours carry over if I don’t use them?

No. They reset at the start of each period. Extra hours are different: they never expire.

Do recordings I never transcribe use hours?

No. Hours are used when audio is sent to be transcribed, not when you record it.

What happens when my hours run out?

Your recording is kept and the transcription waits. See what happens when hours run out.
